Immune Shadow, Trip, Sleep, Charm, Gravity, Confuse, Bleed, Death effects;
Resist Wind 5, Earth 15, Ice 20, Fire 20, Lightning 10;

5th (DC 23) - Bioga, Black Spot, Bone Explosion, Darkga, Deny Death, Drain, Painga, Repurpose, Shadow Summoning, Suffocation, Summon Undead V

SQ Does Not Eat, Does Not Sleep, Does Not Breathe
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Gemini (su) This Burst Mode lets the shamaness within Zalera's right wing begin to act independently, casting spells to support him. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Zalera gains an additional standard action during each round, which can only be used to cast spells.

Lv.3 Disable (su) Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Zalera tunes of shattering wills to all enemies within a 30 ft. radius of himself with a total HD that is a multiple of 3 must make a Will save (DC 28) or be inflicted with the Disabled status effect for 3d3 turns. Blue Mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 25).

Lv.4 Reverse (su) Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Zalera uses his dark magic to make healing effects harmful. All enemies within a 30 ft. radius of Zalera with a total HD that is a multiple of 4 must make a Will save (DC 28) or have healing effects damage them for 4d3 turns. Blue Mages may learn this as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 25).

Lv.5 Death (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, Zalera summons its companion to steal the souls of those within a 30 ft. radius of him. All creatures with a total HD that is a multiple of 5 must make a Fortitude save (DC 28) or die. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th-level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 25).

parsed.description: Heretic scion who wrapped the world in dark energies, seeking to take the souls of all living things unto himself. Created in opposition to Emet-Selch, Angel of Truth, and scion of light. Originally tasked with the judging of men upon their deaths, his soul was tainted by the curses of those who raged against the heavens, and seizing one of the gods' servants, a shamaness, as a hostage, he rebelled against his creators. Even now, in defeat, he clutches the shamaness to him in his right arm, and with the aid of her death-wail he summon the soul of darkness to do his bidding. - KenjiGoombah

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
